title: Father and Toddler on Porch Steps, 1942 Regina Canada Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
MAY 11 1942
CHICAGO PHOTO SUPPLIES
1833 SCARTH STREET
REGINA, SASK.
CERTIFIED BY THE PHOTO FINISHING INSTITUTE 10 POINT Nutone PROCESS
686
description: A deckle-edged black and white snapshot capturing an affectionate moment between a father and his young child on the wooden steps of house number 101. The man is dressed smartly in a heavy tweed three-piece suit with a tie, looking downward tenderly at his toddler. The child stands between his knees wearing a warm wool winter coat, leggings, and a white brimmed hat. Developed by Chicago Photo Supplies on Scarth Street in Regina, Saskatchewan, during the spring of 1942, this domestic scene reflects everyday Canadian home life during World War II.
